My 0.11 hectare plot has some perennial crops — maybe coffee or fruit trees — and I need to take care of it with what little I have. I will not buy chemical fertilizer for this plot because the small amount of DAP and urea I can get from the cooperative must go to my food crops so my family has enough to eat. Instead, I will spread manure and compost here, which we collect from our animals at no cost. My family and I will do all the work ourselves — weeding, pruning, and harvesting — because the plot is small and paying workers is too expensive for me.
